methodology.countryMeaning: Historical chess affiliation, not a FIDE federation registration or birthplace.
methodology.completeness: All world ranks through the fifth Soviet player are audited; other country top fives are not inferred.
methodology.temporalLimit: Some January 1927 exclusions infer continuity from national careers around the cutoff; notes identify these cases. No exact-month registration record is claimed.
methodology.neutralCases: Where only exclusion from the Soviet country pool is established, countryCode remains null.
